entities.name: Felipe Massa
entities.description: Finished second in the 2012 Japanese Grand Prix, his first podium result since the 2010 Korean Grand Prix.

entities.name: Kamui Kobayashi
entities.description: Claimed the first podium of his career in the 2012 Japanese Grand Prix, the first podium for a Japanese driver at the Suzuka Circuit since Aguri Suzuki in 1990.
